thumb.text: The storefront is a contract: icon, thumbnail, title and short video form one promise. Healthy chain: image, expectation, play, confirmation. Toxic chain: image, expectation, play, broken promise, bounce.
A good thumbnail compresses one of: transformation, threat, scale, rarity, conflict, comparison, status, before and after, reveal, absurd, visual question.
The best sold moment has to exist quickly in the product. A thumbnail that promises something the first minutes do not deliver breaks the chain.
Hook test used by the weekly report: a Roblox kid recognizes it in under a second and it drops into an existing game's art without changing the game.
Eggs hook used in Dylan's egg event: creatives did not perform. No CTR numbers reported. Eggs moved to the bottom of the ranking.
Keep listing kills separate from concept kills when reading a test (listing problem versus concept problem).

titulo.text: Plain communication beats plain gameplay: Roblox needs a legible promise. Verb plus noun is a heuristic, not a law. Easy to understand does not mean shallow to master.
The storefront is a contract: the title is part of the promise the thumbnail makes.
"+1" titles: about 22 rising titles on Oct 12, for example +1 Stone Skipping 56K, +1 Mog Evolution 19K.
"STEAL" in the title: about 22 titles on Oct 12, for example Break and Steal an Egg 137K. Eggs clones are decaying, so check the theme before copying the word.
"Survive N Days": 7 Days Cat-Sitting 37.8K, 100 Days At Sea 17.3K, Survive 7 Days In Arctic 9.6K.
"Verb THE Object!" chore titles: Peel THE Potato 16.8K, Melt All The Ice 9.4K, Renovate A House 6.9K. One object, one chore verb.
Live tags and timers in titles: [EVENT] Ride A Pet 101K, [BLOOD MOON] in Pet Simulator 99. Keyboard Escape swaps its multiplier daily.
Pumpkin emoji in the title: about 22 rising titles on Oct 12. Calendar window ends 2026-10-31.
